attr.title: Art of War 2: Global Confederation
attr.desc: Real-time strategy from HeroCraft. Build a base, train infantry and vehicles, research upgrades and fight through seven campaign missions. The original Java ME game runs natively on a small built-in runtime, with no emulator.
attr.inst: Copy ArtOfWar2__Nokia_5800.jar from your own copy of the Nokia 5800 edition (version 1.4.0) to ports/artofwar2/gamedata/.
